### Every non-trivial call, by distinct junction

One line per cohort x gene pair x breakpoints x Pfam family x class; every sample with that junction is listed with its reads (`split/pairs`, MSK precision, open-table FFPM and FusionInspector validation). Frame: `translated` is the screen's both-bases-retained convention, `alt` drops the reported 3' base. Genomic column: sub-checks that fired (`sim150`/`sim500` = breakpoint windows >=80% identical over >=100 bp, `rep` = segdup/RepeatMasker, `burdenN` = sample has N shared-family calls, `reads` = 0 split reads or imprecise); `burden` and `reads` are per sample, so the column shows the union. Per-row reasons are in the TSVs.
